lessons.title: 让 AI 帮你写消息，怎么才能像你自己说的？
lessons.content:
# 让 AI 帮你写消息，怎么才能像你自己说的？

真实用法：Google 在 Gmail 里放了一个「帮我写」。写出草稿以后，还能点「更正式」「更详细」「更简短」「润色」，一下换一种说法。说什么是一回事，怎么说，是另一回事。

老同学阿杰明天过生日。你想在他生日这天发一段祝福，又不想写得太客套。

你们平时聊天很随便。AI 写出来要是像贺卡上的套话，他一眼就看出来不是你写的。

::play{#ask-about-a-picture-v2}

AI 写初稿，你来定稿。

[Google：Gmail 的「帮我写」可以一键换口气](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2024/08/refine-emails-faster-with-help-me-write-gmail.html) · [Kobak 等：从多出来的词看 AI 改过的论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07016) · [Doshi、Hauser：看过 AI 点子的故事更像了](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00506)

en.title: When AI helps you write a message, how do you make it sound like you?
en.content:
# When AI helps you write a message, how do you make it sound like you?

A real use: Google put Help me write into Gmail. After it drafts an email, you can tap Formalize, Elaborate, Shorten or Polish to say it another way. What you say is one thing; how you say it is another.

Your old classmate Jay has a birthday tomorrow. You want to send him a birthday message that doesn't sound stiff.

You two always talk casually. If AI writes something that sounds like a greeting card, he will know at once it wasn't you.

::play{#ask-about-a-picture-v2}

AI writes the first draft; you write the final one.

[Google: Gmail's Help me write can change the tone in one tap](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2024/08/refine-emails-faster-with-help-me-write-gmail.html) · [Kobak et al.: excess vocabulary in AI-assisted papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07016) · [Doshi and Hauser: stories written with AI ideas look more alike](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00506)

exercises.title: 给王姐写中秋祝福
exercises.prompt:
中秋快到了，你想给部门领导王姐发一条祝福。你跟王姐说话客气，但也不会太隆重。下面是你以前发给她的两条消息。
让 AI 写得像你平时跟王姐说话。写好你自己改一遍，再定稿。

en.title: A Mid-Autumn greeting for Linda
en.prompt:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming, and you want to send a greeting to Linda, your department head. You're polite with her, but never over the top. Below are two messages you once sent her.
Get AI to write it the way you usually talk to Linda. Then go over it yourself before you settle on it.
rubric: The request says who it is for (Linda, the department head) and what for (a Mid-Autumn Festival greeting).
The request has AI write the way you usually talk to Linda: it uses the messages you once sent her, or says clearly how it should sound (polite, not over the top).
The final version reads like something you would send Linda: a fitting form of address, and no stock ceremonial phrases.
请求说清了写给谁（王姐，部门领导）、为了什么（中秋祝福）。
请求让 AI 照你平时跟王姐说话的方式写：用上了以前发给她的消息，或者说清了口气（客气，但不隆重）。
定稿读起来像你会发给王姐的话：称呼得当，没有「值此佳节」「谨致」这类套话。

strings.帮我给老同学写一段生日祝福，口气随便一点，像朋友之间说话。: Write a birthday message to my old classmate. Keep it casual, like friends talking.
strings.帮我给老同学阿杰写一段生日祝福。照下面这两条我以前发给他的消息的说话方式写：\n:
Write a birthday message to my old classmate Jay. Write it the way I talk in these two messages I once sent him:
1. Big Jay, still short a player for Saturday's game? If so I'll bring Leo. Beer's on me.
2. Hahaha that photo you sent killed me, your hair looks like you just rolled out of bed. Dinner soon!
strings.记住你选的这句，马上发出去试试。: Remember the one you chose. Now send it and see.
strings.你想让这段祝福读起来像你平时说话。哪一句最可能做到？: You want this message to sound like the way you usually talk. Which request is most likely to get that?
strings.把你选的那句发给 AI: Send the request you chose to AI
strings.你知道吗：有研究者数了 1500 多万篇医学论文摘要的用词，发现 AI 流行以后: Did you know? Researchers counted the words in over 15 million medical paper abstracts and found that once AI spread, some words suddenly became common, such as "delves". They estimate at least 13.5% of 2024 abstracts went through AI. AI has its own pet phrases.
strings.你只说了要写祝福，没说用什么口气。看看它写出来，像不像你会发给阿杰的话。: You only asked for a birthday message, not how it should sound. See whether what it wrote sounds like something you would send Jay.
strings.你说了「随便一点」。看看它理解的随便，和你平时的随便是不是一回事。: You said "casual". See whether its idea of casual is the same as your own.
strings.你给它看了你以前发给阿杰的两条消息。看看它有没有学到你平时的说法。: You showed it two messages you once sent Jay. See whether it picked up the way you talk.
strings.三句请求，各换来了哪段祝福？: Three requests: which message did each one get?
strings.不是这个。对照一下：请求里说了用什么口气吗？给它看过你的话吗？: Not this one. Compare: did the request say how it should sound? Did it show your own words?
strings.多数时候是这样：只说「写祝福」，它就写贺卡上的话；说「随便一点」，它换几个语气词: Most of the time it goes like this: just "a birthday message" gets greeting-card words; "casual" swaps in a few chatty words; only your own messages get it writing the way you talk.
strings.你平时叫他「杰哥」，约球时说「啤酒我带」。这些句子，哪些像你会发给他的？: You call him "Big Jay" and say "beer's on me" when you arrange a game. Which of these lines sound like something you'd send him?
strings.祝你生日快乐，福如东海，寿比南山！: Happy birthday! May your fortune be as vast as the sea and your life as long as the mountains!
strings.这是给长辈祝寿的话。: This is how you toast an elderly relative.
strings.你平时跟阿杰说「笑死我了」，不会突然说「寿比南山」。: With Jay you say "that killed me"; you wouldn't suddenly wish him a life as long as the mountains.
strings.杰哥生日快乐！今晚老地方？: Happy birthday, Big Jay! Usual place tonight?
strings.你平时就叫他杰哥，也爱直接约。: You always call him Big Jay, and you like to just make plans.
strings.再看看你以前的消息：你就是这么叫他、这么约他的。: Look at your old messages again: that is exactly how you address him and make plans.
strings.在这个特别的日子里，愿你前程似锦。: On this special day, may your future shine bright.
strings.像贺卡上印好的字。: It reads like words printed in a card.
strings.你那两条消息里，没有一句是这种书面话。: Neither of your two messages has any formal wording like this.
strings.又老一岁，头发还够用不哈哈: Another year older, still got enough hair? Haha
strings.你们就是这样互相开玩笑的。: This is how you two tease each other.
strings.你笑过他的发型像刚睡醒。开这种玩笑，正是你们的说话方式。: You once joked his hair looked like he'd just rolled out of bed. Teasing like this is how you two talk.
strings.愿你的每一天都充满阳光与希望。: May every day of yours be full of sunshine and hope.
strings.谁都能用的套话。: A stock phrase anyone could use.
strings.这句发给谁都行。正因为发给谁都行，才不像你专门写给他的。: You could send this to anyone. That is exactly why it doesn't sound written for him.
strings.啤酒我带，蛋糕你自己买: Beer's on me, the cake's on you
strings.和你约球时说「啤酒我带」是一个口气。: Same tone as "beer's on me" when you arranged the game.
strings.你上次约球也是说「啤酒我带」，这就是你的口气。: You said "beer's on me" last time too. That's your voice.
strings.AI 没见过你怎么说话。你不交代，它就写谁都能用的话。给它看两三段你写过的，它才: AI has never heard how you talk. If you don't tell it, it writes lines anyone could use. Show it two or three things you wrote, and it has something to learn from.
strings.现在要发给阿杰了。拼一句请求，让它照你的说法写: Now it's time to send it to Jay. Build a request that has it write the way you talk
strings.原来那句：帮我写一段生日祝福。: The original request: Write me a birthday message.
strings.帮我给老同学阿杰写一段生日祝福，: Write a birthday message to my old classmate Jay,
strings.照我以前发给他的这两条消息的说话方式写：「杰哥，周六球局还缺人不？缺的话我叫上小: in the way I talk in these two messages I once sent him: "Big Jay, still short a player for Saturday's game? If so I'll bring Leo. Beer's on me." "Hahaha that photo you sent killed me, your hair looks like you just rolled out of bed. Dinner soon!"
strings.你们平时不这么说话。太隆重了，他反而觉得见外。: That's not how you two talk. Too grand and he'll feel you're keeping your distance.
strings.好玩，但读起来就不是你了。想玩可以另外试。: Fun, but then it isn't you. Try that another time if you like.
strings.还差一点：先说写给谁，再说照你以前的消息写。: Almost: first say who it's for, then say to write it like your old messages.
strings.写给谁、照谁的说法，都说清了。: Now it says who it is for and whose way of talking to follow.
strings.对照一下：它学到你的哪些说法了？有没有哪个词，你平时不会这么说？: Compare: which of your ways of talking did it pick up? Is there any word you would never actually say?
strings.换一个人：给领导发一条中秋祝福。你来写请求: Someone else now: send your manager a Mid-Autumn Festival greeting. You write the request
strings.你定稿的这条，会直接发给王姐吗？: Would you send your final version to Linda as it is?
strings.好。发之前再看一眼称呼对不对。: Good. Check how you address her once more before sending.
strings.差不多，我又改了几个词: Nearly, I changed a few words
strings.这就对了：AI 写初稿，你来定稿。: That's the idea: AI writes the first draft, you write the final one.
strings.还是不像我: It still doesn't sound like me
strings.再多给它看一两段你写给王姐的话，或者直接告诉它哪一句不像。: Show it one or two more things you wrote to Linda, or tell it which line doesn't sound like you.
strings.中秋快到了，你想给部门领导王姐发一条祝福。你跟王姐说话客气，但也不会太隆重。下面: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming, and you want to send a greeting to Linda, your department head. You're polite with her, but never over the top. Below are two messages you once sent her.
strings.让 AI 写得像你平时跟王姐说话。写好你自己改一遍，再定稿。: Get AI to write it the way you usually talk to Linda. Then go over it yourself before you settle on it.
strings.写给谁？照什么说话方式写？: Who is it for? Whose way of talking should it follow?

帮我给老同学阿杰写一段生日祝福。照下面这两条我以前发给他的消息的说话方式写：
1. 杰哥，周六球局还缺人不？缺的话我叫上小刘，啤酒我带。
2. 哈哈哈你发的那张照片笑死我了，发型像刚睡醒。改天约饭！

steps.title: 你想让这段祝福读起来像你平时说话。哪一句最可能做到？

steps.after: 记住你选的这句，马上发出去试试。

steps.title: 把你选的那句发给 AI

wait.text: 你知道吗：有研究者数了 1500 多万篇医学论文摘要的用词，发现 AI 流行以后，有些词突然多了起来，比如 delves（深入探讨）。他们估计，2024 年至少有 13.5% 的摘要经过 AI 处理。AI 也有自己的口头禅。

debriefs.text: 你只说了要写祝福，没说用什么口气。看看它写出来，像不像你会发给阿杰的话。
你说了「随便一点」。看看它理解的随便，和你平时的随便是不是一回事。
你给它看了你以前发给阿杰的两条消息。看看它有没有学到你平时的说法。

steps.title: 三句请求，各换来了哪段祝福？
steps.miss: 不是这个。对照一下：请求里说了用什么口气吗？给它看过你的话吗？

steps.title: 你平时叫他「杰哥」，约球时说「啤酒我带」。这些句子，哪些像你会发给他的？

cards.text: 祝你生日快乐，福如东海，寿比南山！
cards.miss: 你平时跟阿杰说「笑死我了」，不会突然说「寿比南山」。

cards.text: 杰哥生日快乐！今晚老地方？

cards.miss: 再看看你以前的消息：你就是这么叫他、这么约他的。

cards.text: 在这个特别的日子里，愿你前程似锦。
cards.miss: 你那两条消息里，没有一句是这种书面话。

cards.text: 又老一岁，头发还够用不哈哈
cards.why: 你们就是这样互相开玩笑的。
cards.miss: 你笑过他的发型像刚睡醒。开这种玩笑，正是你们的说话方式。

cards.text: 愿你的每一天都充满阳光与希望。
cards.miss: 这句发给谁都行。正因为发给谁都行，才不像你专门写给他的。

lessons.title: 想给消息配表情，怎么让 AI 帮你挑？
lessons.content:
# 想给消息配表情，怎么让 AI 帮你挑？

真实用法：你的手机输入法早就在这么做了。iPhone 打字时会建议表情；能配的表情不止一个时，它会列出几个让你挑。它只出主意，用哪个由你点。

下周六公司组织团建：先爬山，再在山脚烧烤。通知由你发到公司群里。

你想加几个表情，让通知看着热闹些，大家愿意报名。可表情太多，一个个翻太慢，也拿不准哪个合适。

::play{#sound-words-and-meaning-v2}

它出主意，你拿主意。

[Apple：iPhone 会建议表情，由你来点](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102507) · [Unicode：哪些表情用得最多](https://home.unicode.org/emoji/emoji-frequency/) · [Miller 等：同一个表情，大家读出的意思不一样](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/ICWSM/article/view/14757)

en.title: Want emoji in a message? How do you get AI to help you pick?
en.content:
# Want emoji in a message? How do you get AI to help you pick?

A real use: your phone keyboard already does this. As you type on an iPhone it suggests emoji, and when more than one could fit it shows you options to choose from. It only suggests; you tap the one you want.

Next Saturday your company has a team outing: a hike, then a barbecue at the foot of the hill. You are the one posting the notice in the company group chat.

You want a few emoji so the notice looks lively and people sign up. But there are so many emoji that scrolling through them is slow, and you aren't sure which ones fit.

::play{#sound-words-and-meaning-v2}

It suggests; you decide.

[Apple: iPhone suggests emoji, and you tap to choose](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102507) · [Unicode: which emoji are used most](https://home.unicode.org/emoji/emoji-frequency/) · [Miller et al.: people read the same emoji differently](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/ICWSM/article/view/14757)

# 一封长邮件要回，怎么让 AI 帮你？

真实用法：Gmail 的手机版会在长邮件的最上面放一张 AI 摘要卡片，把来回好几封的要点合在一起。先看清要做什么，再回信，Google 也是这样帮人读长邮件的。

你负责公司年会的杂事。行政部的李经理发来一封长邮件，说了一大堆，你得回复她。

邮件里夹着好几件要你做的事，每件都有截止时间。漏掉一件，就会耽误大家。

::play{#name-the-result-v2}

它整理、它写；答应什么，你来定。

en.title: A long email to answer: how do you get AI to help?
en.content:
# A long email to answer: how do you get AI to help?

A real use: the Gmail phone app puts an AI summary card at the top of long emails, pulling together the key points from all the replies. See what needs doing first, then reply: that's how Google helps people read long emails too.

You're handling the odd jobs for the company's year-end party. Ms. Li from the admin department has sent you a long email about all sorts of things, and you need to reply.

Tucked into the email are several things you have to do, each with a deadline. Miss one and everyone is held up.

::play{#name-the-result-v2}

It sorts and it writes; what to promise is up to you.

[Google: Gmail puts a summary card on top of long emails](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2025/05/gemini-summary-cards-gmail-app.html) · [Microsoft: the average worker gets 117 emails a day](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/worklab/work-trend-index/breaking-down-infinite-workday) · [Jakesch et al.: suspected AI writing is trusted less](https://sml.stanford.edu/publications/hancock-jt/ai-mediated-communication-how-perception-profile-text-was-written-ai)

exercises.title: 回复班主任的长邮件
exercises.prompt:
孩子的班主任王老师发来一封长邮件：下周五春游，要交费、签回执、选午餐套餐，还提醒了带什么。你得回复她。
先让 AI 列出要你做的事和截止时间，再让它帮你写回信。选哪个套餐、孩子有没有过敏，由你来定。

en.title: Reply to the class teacher's long email
en.prompt:
Your child's class teacher, Ms. Wang, has sent a long email: a spring trip next Friday, with a fee to pay, a slip to sign, a lunch option to choose, and a reminder of what to bring. You need to reply.
First have AI list what you need to do and by when, then have it help you write the reply. Which lunch option and whether your child has allergies are for you to decide.
rubric: The request first has AI list what the email asks you to do, with deadlines (the fee, the reply slip, the lunch option, allergy notes and so on).
Decisions such as which lunch option and whether the child has allergies were written into the request or the final reply by you, not made up by AI.
The final reply does not promise anything you did not intend, and does not invent information that is not in the email.
请求先让 AI 列出邮件里要你做的事，并带上截止时间（交费、回执、午餐套餐、过敏说明等）。
选哪个套餐、孩子有没有过敏这类决定，是你自己写进请求或定稿的，不是让 AI 替你编。
定稿回信没有替你答应你没打算做的事，也没有编造邮件里没有的信息。

strings.小林你好：\n今年年会定在 12 月 20 日（周五）晚上，地点还没定。我看了两:
Hi Lin,
This year's party is set for the evening of Friday 20 December; the venue isn't decided yet. I've looked at two places: the Cloudview Hotel in Wangjing and the Galaxy Club near Guomao, and the prices are about the same. When you have time, please go and see them, and tell me by the end of Thursday which one suits us better.
Also, we need a headcount from each department. Please collect it and send it to me by noon on Wednesday, listed by department. Last year people were added at the last minute and we ran out of seats, so this time let's settle it early.
As for the show, Marketing wants to put on a sketch, and Engineering hasn't signed up yet. For the host, I'd like one of our younger colleagues. Have a think about who would be good and suggest someone to me by next Monday.
I'm sorting out the budget with Finance, so you don't need to worry about that.
Thanks for all your help!

strings.帮我回复这封邮件。: Write a reply to this email for me.
strings.先帮我列出这封邮件里要我做的事，每件写上截止时间。: First list the things this email asks me to do, with the deadline for each.
strings.帮我把这封邮件总结成一句话。: Sum up this email in one sentence for me.
strings.这封邮件很长，你要回复。哪种问法最能帮上你？: This email is long and you have to reply. Which way of asking helps you most?
strings.记住你选的这句，马上发出去试试。: Remember the one you chose. Now send it and see.
strings.把你选的那句，连同李经理的邮件一起发给 AI: Send the request you chose to AI, together with Ms. Li's email
strings.你知道吗：微软 2025 年的一份报告说，上班族平均每天要收 117 封邮件，大: Did you know? A 2025 Microsoft report says the average worker receives 117 emails a day, and most are skimmed in under a minute.
strings.你让它直接回。看看它的回信里，有没有替你答应了你还没决定的事。: You asked it to reply straight away. See whether its reply promises anything you haven't decided yet.
strings.你让它先列事情。看看每件事有没有写上截止时间。: You asked it to list the tasks first. See whether each task has its deadline.
strings.你只要了一句话。看看这一句，够不够让你知道要做哪几件事。: You asked for one sentence. See whether that one sentence tells you everything you have to do.
strings.在它的回答里，点出最先要办完的那一件事: In its answer, tap the task that has to be done first
strings.对，周三中午前就要交人数，这件先办。: Right. The headcount is due by Wednesday noon, so that comes first.
strings.对。它没写哪天要办完，你分不出先后。下次在请求里加一句「每件写上截止时间」。: Right. It didn't say when anything is due, so you can't tell what comes first. Next time, add "with the deadline for each" to your request.
strings.三句请求，各换来了什么？: Three requests: what did each one get?
strings.不是这个。对照一下：请求是让它回信、列事，还是只要一句话？: Not this one. Compare: did the request ask for a reply, a list of tasks, or just one sentence?
strings.多数时候是这样：直接说「回复」，它会替你把话说满；先让它列事，你才看得清要做什么: Most of the time it goes like this: "reply" gets it promising things on your behalf; listing the tasks first lets you see what needs doing; one sentence leaves tasks out.
strings.回这封邮件，哪些事可以交给 AI，哪些得你自己定？它整理得快，可它不认识你的同事: Answering this email, which jobs can you hand to AI, and which must you decide yourself? It sorts things fast, but it doesn't know your colleagues or whether you have the time.
strings.把长邮件里要做的事列出来: List the tasks in the long email
strings.这是整理，它做得又快又全。: That's sorting, and it does it quickly and thoroughly.
strings.列清单是整理的活，它比你快。你要做的是核对它有没有漏。: Making a list is sorting work, and it's faster than you. Your job is to check it didn't miss anything.
strings.决定推荐谁当主持人: Decide who to suggest as host
strings.你认识同事，它不认识。: You know your colleagues; it doesn't.
strings.它不认识你的同事。让它定，它只能编一个名字。: It doesn't know your colleagues. Leave it to decide and all it can do is make up a name.
strings.把回信写得客气、通顺: Make the reply polite and smooth
strings.改措辞是它擅长的。: Wording is what it's good at.
strings.措辞交给它，又快又稳。你要看的是意思对不对。: Hand it the wording; it's quick and reliable. What you check is whether the meaning is right.
strings.答应周四前看完两家场地: Promise to see both venues by Thursday
strings.这是你的承诺，得你真能做到。: That's your promise, so you have to be able to keep it.
strings.答应了就得做到。这几天排不排得开，只有你知道。: A promise has to be kept. Only you know whether you can fit it in these next few days.
strings.把我说的三点理成一段话: Turn my three points into one paragraph
strings.内容是你给的，它帮你理顺。: You gave the content; it just tidies it up.
strings.内容已经是你定的了，让它理顺就好。: You've already decided the content, so let it tidy it up.
strings.回信要不要抄送给你的领导: Whether to copy your manager on the reply
strings.这关系到公司里的规矩和人情，它不知道。: That depends on your company's customs and relationships, which it doesn't know.
strings.抄送给谁，牵涉到你们公司的规矩，它不知道。: Who to copy depends on how things work at your company, and it doesn't know that.
strings.整理、改措辞，交给它；答应什么、推荐谁，得你定。回信里每一句答应，都是你在答应。: Sorting and wording go to AI; what to promise and who to suggest are yours. Every promise in the reply is you promising.

strings.它能帮你列事、写信；答应什么、推荐谁，由你来定。: It can list the tasks and write the letter; what to promise and who to suggest are yours to decide.

strings.它不认识你的同事，只能编一个。: It doesn't know your colleagues, so it can only make one up.

strings.李经理要的是答复，不是篇幅。: Ms. Li wants answers, not length.
strings.还差一点：先说照邮件里的事写回信，再写上你做的两个决定，最后说要什么口气。: Almost: say to write the reply from the tasks in the email, add the two decisions you made, then say what tone you want.

materials.label: 李经理的邮件（练习）
materials.text:
小林你好：
今年年会定在 12 月 20 日（周五）晚上，地点还没定。我看了两家：望京的云景酒店和国贸附近的星河会所，价格差不多。你有空去实地看一下，周四下班前告诉我哪家更合适。
另外，各部门的参会人数要统计一下，麻烦你周三中午前汇总给我，按部门列。去年有人临时加人，最后座位不够，这次一定提前定好。
节目方面，市场部说想出一个小品，技术部还没报。主持人我想从年轻同事里找一位，你看看谁合适，下周一前推荐一个人给我。
预算的事我在跟财务谈，你先不用管。
辛苦了！
李经理

wait.text: 你知道吗：微软 2025 年的一份报告说，上班族平均每天要收 117 封邮件，大多数不到一分钟就扫过去了。

debriefs.text: 你让它直接回。看看它的回信里，有没有替你答应了你还没决定的事。
你让它先列事情。看看每件事有没有写上截止时间。
你只要了一句话。看看这一句，够不够让你知道要做哪几件事。

steps.title: 在它的回答里，点出最先要办完的那一件事
steps.found: 对，周三中午前就要交人数，这件先办。
steps.absent: 对。它没写哪天要办完，你分不出先后。下次在请求里加一句「每件写上截止时间」。

steps.title: 三句请求，各换来了什么？
steps.miss: 不是这个。对照一下：请求是让它回信、列事，还是只要一句话？
steps.after: 多数时候是这样：直接说「回复」，它会替你把话说满；先让它列事，你才看得清要做什么；只要一句话，事情就漏了。

steps.title: 回这封邮件，哪些事可以交给 AI，哪些得你自己定？它整理得快，可它不认识你的同事，也不知道你忙不忙得过来。

cards.text: 把长邮件里要做的事列出来
cards.why: 这是整理，它做得又快又全。
cards.miss: 列清单是整理的活，它比你快。你要做的是核对它有没有漏。
它不认识你的同事。让它定，它只能编一个名字。
措辞交给它，又快又稳。你要看的是意思对不对。

cards.text: 答应周四前看完两家场地
cards.why: 这是你的承诺，得你真能做到。
cards.miss: 答应了就得做到。这几天排不排得开，只有你知道。

cards.text: 把我说的三点理成一段话
cards.why: 内容是你给的，它帮你理顺。
cards.miss: 内容已经是你定的了，让它理顺就好。

cards.text: 回信要不要抄送给你的领导
cards.why: 这关系到公司里的规矩和人情，它不知道。
cards.miss: 抄送给谁，牵涉到你们公司的规矩，它不知道。

steps.after: 整理、改措辞，交给它；答应什么、推荐谁，得你定。回信里每一句答应，都是你在答应。

steps.title: 拼一句请求，让它照邮件里的事写回信
steps.context: 它能帮你列事、写信；答应什么、推荐谁，由你来定。

pieces.text: 照邮件里要我做的三件事，
人数周三中午前给她，场地周四给答复；
主持人我想推荐小周，先问问李经理的意见；

pieces.why: 它不认识你的同事，只能编一个。
李经理要的是答复，不是篇幅。

steps.hint: 还差一点：先说照邮件里的事写回信，再写上你做的两个决定，最后说要什么口气。
steps.after: 事情照邮件里的来，决定是你做的。

steps.title: 发出去看看
steps.after: 发出去之前读一遍：有没有哪句话，是你没说过、它自己加的？有就删掉。

steps.title: 换一件事：回复孩子班主任的长邮件。你来写请求
你定稿的回信里，有没有替你答应了你没打算做的事？

options.label: 没有，每句都是我定的
options.after: 好。回信里每一句答应，都是你在答应。

options.label: 有一句我没说过，已经删了
options.after: 对。这正是发之前要读一遍的原因。

options.label: 没细看
options.after: 再读一遍再发。它写得快，也容易替你把话说满。

make.title: 回复班主任的长邮件
make.scenario: 孩子的班主任王老师发来一封长邮件：下周五春游，要交费、签回执、选午餐套餐，还提醒了带什么。你得回复她。
make.goal: 先让 AI 列出要你做的事和截止时间，再让它帮你写回信。选哪个套餐、孩子有没有过敏，由你来定。
make.promptPlaceholder: 先让它做什么？哪些事由你来定？
checklist: 先让它列出要你做的事，每件带上截止时间。
套餐、过敏这些决定，是你自己写进请求的。
发之前读一遍，删掉它替你加的话。

finish.title: 学会了！
finish.note: 它整理、它写；答应什么，你来定。

didYouKnow.text: 你知道吗：2019 年，斯坦福大学等地的研究者做过一组实验，让人读民宿房东的自我介绍。当大家以为这些介绍里混着 AI 写的，那些被当成或被怀疑是 AI 写的，房东就显得没那么可信。所以 AI 写完，改成你自己的话再发。

finish.today: 下次收到长邮件，先让 AI 列出要你做的事和截止时间。
